concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage table (FR-009, FR-010 rows)
concerns.text: Coverage table cites `pytest tests/unit/test_sensitivity.py` and `tests/unit/test_significance.py` as demonstrating commands, but no task names these files as deliverables — T010/T011 list only artifact files and say 'Test asserts…' without a test-file path. Either add the test files to T010/T011 deliverables or fix the table to cite the actual verification.

'Each figure file exists and is regenerated deterministically from the artifact JSON/CSVs by re-running the reporting step' — no concrete command or test is named. Specify the command (e.g. `python -m code.main --report-only` or a pytest that re-runs and compares file hashes) so the implementer can verify deterministically.

'Reviewer confirms every reported number traces to an artifact file' is not machine-executable verification. Add a concrete check, e.g. a script/test that extracts numeric claims from research.md and matches them against artifact JSON values, or at minimum a named checklist command.

'matches published formulas to within 1e-6 on a hand-crafted row' — the task does not name the reference values or where the expected outputs come from. Specify the hand-crafted input row and expected epsilon/Newell values (or state they are computed independently in the test) so the implementer can write the assertion.

Tasks declare plan.md as an input, but plan.md still mandates `generate_synthetic_data.py` and an exclusively synthetic pipeline that tasks.md forbids. An implementer reading the declared inputs gets contradictory instructions (e.g. plan's Phase 1 command no longer exists). tasks.md should note plan.md is superseded on data sourcing, or plan.md must be updated — otherwise T003 is not self-contained against its declared inputs.

Integration test fetches real CDAWeb data; the task should state whether the fetch test is skipped/marked when network is unavailable in CI, or whether a cached fixture under data/raw/ is the test input, so the verification is executable on a fresh runner.
